description: Remove the aspect ratio preset selector (1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, Custom buttons) from the Canvas Settings panel.
stepsToVerify: Open the Fragment Generator UI.
Inspect the Canvas Settings section.
Confirm there are no aspect ratio preset buttons anywhere in the controls.

description: Remove the custom aspect ratio width/height inputs and all associated state (aspectRatioPreset, customAspectRatio, customRatioWidthInput, customRatioHeightInput, customRatioWidthError, customRatioHeightError, currentAspectRatio).
stepsToVerify: Search the codebase for 'aspectRatio', 'customRatio', 'AspectRatio' references.
Confirm no aspect-ratio-related state, types, or UI elements remain in AssetGenerator.tsx.
Confirm no aspect-ratio-related utilities remain in dimensionUtils.ts (e.g. calculateHeight, validateAspectRatioValue).

description: Make the Height field an editable number input (currently it is read-only/disabled and auto-calculated from width and aspect ratio).
stepsToVerify: Open the Fragment Generator UI.
Locate the Height input field in Canvas Settings.
Confirm it is an editable text/number input, not disabled or read-only.
Type a value (e.g. 500) and confirm it is accepted.

description: Both Width and Height accept integer values in the range 64-4096 px with the same validation behavior (clamp/error) as the current width input.
stepsToVerify: Enter 63 in Width - confirm it is rejected or clamped to 64.
Enter 4097 in Width - confirm it is rejected or clamped to 4096.
Enter 63 in Height - confirm it is rejected or clamped to 64.
Enter 4097 in Height - confirm it is rejected or clamped to 4096.
Enter a decimal (e.g. 100.5) in either field - confirm it is floored to an integer.
Enter a valid value (e.g. 512) in either field - confirm it is accepted without error.

description: Width and Height are fully independent - changing one does NOT affect the other. This applies in ALL modes, including when 'Allow cropping' is enabled. Canvas dimensions are always exactly what the user entered.
stepsToVerify: Set Width to 800 and Height to 600.
Change Width to 1024 - confirm Height remains 600.
Change Height to 768 - confirm Width remains 1024.
Enable 'Allow cropping', set cell size to 37 - confirm Width and Height input fields remain unchanged.

description: Default dimensions on load remain the current defaults (1000x1000).
stepsToVerify: Reload the application.
Confirm Width is 1000 and Height is 1000.

description: When dimensions change, calculate GCD(width, height) and find all divisors of that GCD that are >= dynamicMin and <= 200. The dynamic minimum is max(2, ceil(max(width, height) * 0.01)). Display these as selectable buttons. Buttons wrap naturally within the control panel (no scrolling needed for typical cases of up to ~16 buttons).
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 200x350 (dynamicMin = max(2, ceil(350*0.01)) = 4).
Confirm the available cell size buttons are exactly: 5, 10, 25, 50 (divisors of GCD=50 that are >= 4 and <= 200).
Set dimensions to 1000x1000 (dynamicMin = 10).
Confirm the divisors of GCD(1000,1000)=1000 that are >= 10 and <= 200 are shown (10, 20, 25, 40, 50, 100, 125, 200).
Confirm divisors < 10 (1, 2, 4, 5, 8) and > 200 (250, 500, 1000) are NOT shown.

description: Minimum cell size is dynamic: max(2, ceil(max(width, height) * 0.01)) — roughly 1% of the largest dimension, with a floor of 2px. Divisors below this dynamic minimum are excluded from the valid set to prevent performance issues with extremely small cells.
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 200x350 (dynamicMin = 4). Confirm smallest visible button is 5px (divisors of 50 >= 4).
Set dimensions to 1000x1000 (dynamicMin = 10). Confirm smallest visible button is 10px.
Set dimensions to 64x64 (dynamicMin = 2). Confirm 2px and 4px are available (both divide 64).
Set dimensions to 4096x4096 (dynamicMin = 41). Confirm no buttons below 41px are shown.

description: Remove the 'Custom cell size' freeform input and the old fixed cell size presets (8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64) in normal (non-cropping) mode. Only dynamically calculated valid-size buttons are available.
stepsToVerify: Open the Fragment Generator UI with 'Allow cropping' disabled.
Confirm there is no 'Custom' button or freeform cell size input field.
Confirm the old preset buttons (8px, 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px, 64px) are no longer hardcoded.
Confirm cell size options are entirely derived from GCD divisors.

description: If the previously selected cell size is still in the new valid set after a dimension change, keep it selected.
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 200x400 - select cell size 10.
Change width to 300 (now 300x400, GCD=100, divisors include 10).
Confirm cell size 10 is still selected.

description: If the previously selected cell size is NOT in the new valid set, auto-select the nearest valid cell size. Tie-breaking rule: when two valid sizes are equidistant from the previous value, prefer the larger one.
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 1000x1000 - select cell size 40.
Change dimensions to 200x350 (GCD=50, valid >= 4: 5,10,25,50).
Confirm cell size auto-selects 50 (nearest to 40 in the valid set).
Test tie-breaking: select cell size 15, change to dimensions where valid set is [10, 20] - confirm 20 is selected (larger wins tie).

description: When there are 3 or fewer valid GCD divisors in the [dynamicMin, 200] range, show a hint: 'Few valid sizes. Enable Allow cropping for more options.' When there are ZERO valid divisors (e.g., coprime dimensions like 100x101 where GCD=1), the grid preview and export buttons are disabled. A message is shown: 'No valid sizes for these dimensions. Change dimensions or enable Allow cropping.' The user must change dimensions or enable cropping before rendering resumes.
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 100x101 (GCD=1, zero divisors >= dynamicMin).
Confirm no cell size buttons are shown.
Confirm the grid preview area is disabled/blank.
Confirm export buttons (SVG, Copy SVG, Export JSON) are disabled.
Confirm a message is displayed: 'No valid sizes for these dimensions. Change dimensions or enable Allow cropping.'
Enable 'Allow cropping' - confirm the slider appears, grid renders, and exports are re-enabled.
Disable 'Allow cropping' - confirm the blocking state returns.
Change dimensions to 100x200 (GCD=100, many divisors) - confirm the blocking state clears and buttons appear.

description: Add a checkbox labeled 'Allow cropping' with an info icon. On hover, the tooltip reads: 'Enabling this allows any cell size, even if it doesn't perfectly divide the SVG dimensions. Fragments at the edge will be cropped.'
stepsToVerify: Open the Fragment Generator UI.
Locate a checkbox labeled 'Allow cropping' near the cell size controls.
Hover over the info icon next to the checkbox.
Confirm the tooltip text matches the specified message.

description: When 'Allow cropping' is enabled, the divisor buttons are replaced by a slider with range dynamicMin to 200 (where dynamicMin = max(2, ceil(max(width, height) * 0.01))). The slider allows selecting any integer cell size in that range.
stepsToVerify: Enable 'Allow cropping' with dimensions 500x500 (dynamicMin = 5).
Confirm the valid-divisor buttons are no longer shown.
Confirm a slider is visible with range 5-200.
Slide to value 37 - confirm cell size is set to 37.
Disable 'Allow cropping' - confirm the slider disappears and divisor buttons return.

description: The cropping-mode slider visually marks positions that correspond to GCD divisors >= dynamicMin (evenly divisible sizes). When the slider value lands on a size that divides BOTH the original user-entered width and height, an 'Evenly divisible' indicator is shown next to the slider.
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 200x350 (GCD divisors >= dynamicMin(4): 5,10,25,50). Enable 'Allow cropping'.
Confirm the slider has visible tick marks or indicators at positions 5, 10, 25, and 50.
Slide to value 10 - confirm an 'Evenly divisible' label/indicator appears.
Slide to value 11 - confirm the 'Evenly divisible' indicator disappears.
Slide to value 50 - confirm the indicator reappears.

description: When 'Allow cropping' is enabled, a direction toggle appears with two options: 'Crop width' and 'Crop height', indicating which axis will have cropped (partial) cells at the edge. Default selection is 'Crop height'.
stepsToVerify: Enable 'Allow cropping'.
Confirm a direction toggle with 'Crop width' and 'Crop height' options is visible.
Confirm 'Crop height' is selected by default.
Disable 'Allow cropping' - confirm the direction toggle disappears.

description: Crop width: the rightmost column of cells may be narrower than the cell size (partial cells cropped to fit the canvas width). Only full rows are rendered on the height axis. Empty space (where no cells are rendered) shows the canvas background color with no additional visual treatment. Canvas dimensions never change — the user's entered width and height are always preserved.
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 500x500. Enable 'Allow cropping'. Select 'Crop width' direction.
Set cell size to 37 via slider.
Confirm the Width and Height input fields still show 500 and 500 (unchanged).
Inspect the grid: cols = ceil(500/37) = 14 columns, last column is 500 - 13*37 = 19px wide (cropped).
Inspect the grid: rows = floor(500/37) = 13 full rows, bottom 19px is empty (no partial rows).

description: Crop height: the bottom row of cells may be shorter than the cell size (partial cells cropped to fit the canvas height). Only full columns are rendered on the width axis. Empty space (where no cells are rendered) shows the canvas background color with no additional visual treatment. Canvas dimensions never change.
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 500x500. Enable 'Allow cropping'. Select 'Crop height' direction.
Set cell size to 37 via slider.
Confirm the Width and Height input fields still show 500 and 500 (unchanged).
Inspect the grid: rows = ceil(500/37) = 14 rows, last row is 500 - 13*37 = 19px tall (cropped).
Inspect the grid: cols = floor(500/37) = 13 full columns, right 19px is empty (no partial columns).

description: Remove the automatic dimension/cell-size adjustment logic. Changing cell size no longer snaps dimensions, and changing dimensions no longer adjusts cell size (except to pick the nearest valid size from the new divisor set, or enter the blocking state per PRD-011a if no valid sizes exist).
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 500x500. Select cell size 50.
Change width to 400 - confirm height remains 500, and cell size updates to nearest valid divisor of GCD(400,500)=100.
Change width to 501 (GCD(501,500)=1, zero valid divisors) - confirm grid is disabled and blocking-state message is shown per PRD-011a.
Confirm no 'adjustment warning' toast appears.
Search the codebase for adjustmentWarning - confirm the warning system is removed.

description: Remove the adjustDimensionsAndCellSize and adjustCellSizeForDimensions functions and the useEffect that calls them. Remove the adjustment warning toast UI.
stepsToVerify: Search for 'adjustDimensionsAndCellSize' in the codebase - confirm it is removed.
Search for 'adjustCellSizeForDimensions' in the codebase - confirm it is removed.
Search for 'adjustmentWarning' in the codebase - confirm it is removed.
Confirm no yellow warning toast appears during any user interaction.

description: Update the export JSON format: remove aspectRatioPreset and customAspectRatio fields. Add allowCropping (boolean) and cropDirection ('width' | 'height') fields. When allowCropping is false, cropDirection is omitted from the export. Bump version to '2.0.0'. Note: there is no import/load feature — this is export-only.
stepsToVerify: Export a configuration with 'Allow cropping' enabled and inspect the JSON.
Confirm version is '2.0.0'.
Confirm aspectRatioPreset and customAspectRatio fields are absent.
Confirm allowCropping is true and cropDirection is 'width' or 'height'.
Confirm cellSize, canvasWidth, canvasHeight fields are still present.
Export a configuration with 'Allow cropping' disabled.
Confirm allowCropping is false and cropDirection field is absent.

description: When disabling 'Allow cropping', the current slider cell size value is carried over and the nearest-valid-size logic (PRD-011) is applied to it. If no valid sizes exist for the current dimensions, the blocking state (PRD-011a) is entered. There is no separate 'pre-cropping cell size' memory.
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 500x500. Select cell size 50. Enable 'Allow cropping'. Slide to 37.
Disable 'Allow cropping' - confirm cell size auto-selects nearest valid divisor (50, nearest to 37 in valid set).
Set dimensions to 100x101 (zero valid sizes). Enable 'Allow cropping'. Slide to 37.
Disable 'Allow cropping' - confirm the blocking state is entered (grid disabled, message shown).
